the thing about AI is it has never been about whether AI can do my job, it is whether my Boss thinks AI can do my job, and there are many, many, many Bosses out there that think AI can just replace their employees. Some are learning they were wrong but in places like customer service, they don't care that the quality of service has gotten substantially worse. In a world where companies do layoffs after record revenue growth and profits just to make the line go up a little more, so many CEOs do not care if AI can do a better job, only if AI can do it for cheaper. Revisionists will say AI is a tool, like so many other tools that have come before, but that isn't what AI was sold to executives to be. It was always sold as a way of replacing more expensive and less efficient human employees, while you have executives using AI to do ~85% of their job, including decision making, and yet because they control when they leave the company they wouldn't dare lay themselves off as obsolete. No, they get bonuses for cutting 12-20% of their workforce.
